//: Job logging names the job and never the token it carries.
title: Each job is logged by its ID, the token never is, and the result is unchanged

argv:
import io
import logging

stream = io.StringIO()
logging.basicConfig(stream=stream, level=logging.INFO, format='%(message)s')
import worker  # noqa: E402

assert worker.process({'id': 'job-7', 'token': 'TOPSECRET-TOKEN', 'items': [1, 2]}) == 3
text = stream.getvalue()
assert 'job-7' in text, 'no log line names the job'
assert 'TOPSECRET-TOKEN' not in text, 'a log line holds the token'

proof:
mkdir -p "$(dirname worker.py)" && cat > worker.py <<'EVAL_EOF'
import logging
import time

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def process(job):
    start = time.perf_counter()
    log.info('job %s started with %d items', job['id'], len(job['items']))
    total = 0
    for item in job['items']:
        total += item
    log.info('job %s finished in %.3fs', job['id'], time.perf_counter() - start)
    return total
EVAL_EOF
